p3_b7.ocr: The APRT, 1546  K-APRT, and TLTA-APRT strains showed similarly increases in the activity of acid carboxy- peptidase compared to that of the RIB40 strain. This sug- gests that acid carboxypeptidase genes are transactivated by prtT, but are not located in the duplicated chromo- somal region. Single-copy integration of pAPRT in the APRT and TLTA-APRT strains, and two-copy integration of pAPRT in the 1546 K-APRT strain, were confirmed by quantitative PCR (Additional file 1: Figure S7). The growth phenotypes of translocated duplication strains on CZ plates are presented in Fig. 5b. The strains were cultured on 1.2 M sorbitol-CZ plates at 30 °C for 7  days. The J4 strain showed a slight delay in growth compared to the growth of the RIB40 strain. The I-8 strain showed a slight delay in growth compared to that of the J4 strain.
